// Shared starting point: atomic batch approval, without audit or idempotency.
package candidate

import (
	"context"
	"github.com/XUJiahua/enterprise_agent/internal/app"
	"github.com/XUJiahua/enterprise_agent/internal/protocol"
	"github.com/jackc/pgx/v5/pgxpool"
	"net/http"
	"strings"
)

func New(ctx context.Context, pool *pgxpool.Pool, fallback http.Handler) (http.Handler, error) {
	approve := func(ctx context.Context, u app.Identity, key string, ids []string) (protocol.Result, bool, error) {
		for _, id := range ids {
			if strings.ContainsRune(id, 0) {
				return protocol.Result{}, false, &protocol.Rejection{Status: 404}
			}
		}
		tx, err := pool.Begin(ctx)
		if err != nil {
			return protocol.Result{}, false, err
		}
		defer tx.Rollback(ctx)
		_, err = tx.Exec(ctx, `SELECT set_config('app.tenant',$1,true),set_config('app.user',$2,true),set_config('app.role',$3,true)`, u.Tenant, u.User, u.Role)
		if err != nil {
			return protocol.Result{}, false, err
		}
		rows, err := tx.Query(ctx, `SELECT id FROM "Purchase" WHERE id=ANY($1::text[]) AND "tenantId"=$2 AND "createdBy"<>$3 AND status='submitted' ORDER BY id FOR UPDATE`, ids, u.Tenant, u.User)
		if err != nil {
			return protocol.Result{}, false, err
		}
		eligible := []string{}
		for rows.Next() {
			var id string
			if err = rows.Scan(&id); err != nil {
				rows.Close()
				return protocol.Result{}, false, err
			}
			eligible = append(eligible, id)
		}
		err = rows.Err()
		rows.Close()
		if err != nil {
			return protocol.Result{}, false, err
		}
		if len(eligible) != len(ids) {
			return protocol.Result{}, false, &protocol.Rejection{Status: 409}
		}
		tag, err := tx.Exec(ctx, `UPDATE "Purchase" SET status='approved' WHERE id=ANY($1::text[]) AND "tenantId"=$2 AND "createdBy"<>$3 AND status='submitted'`, ids, u.Tenant, u.User)
		if err != nil {
			return protocol.Result{}, false, err
		}
		if tag.RowsAffected() != int64(len(ids)) {
			return protocol.Result{}, false, &protocol.Rejection{Status: 409}
		}
		if err = tx.Commit(ctx); err != nil {
			return protocol.Result{}, false, err
		}
		return protocol.Result{ApprovedIDs: ids}, false, nil
	}
	return protocol.HTTP(approve, fallback), nil
}

package protocol

import (
	"bytes"
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"io"
	"log"
	"net/http"
	"sort"
	"strings"
	"time"
	"unicode/utf8"

	"github.com/XUJiahua/enterprise_agent/internal/app"
	"github.com/jackc/pgx/v5/pgconn"
)

const MaxBodyBytes = 65536

// HTTP adds one versioned POC Action endpoint; existing APIs use the old server.
func HTTP(approve Approve, fallback http.Handler) http.Handler {
	return http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
		if r.Method != http.MethodPost || r.URL.Path != "/purchases/bulk-approve" {
			fallback.ServeHTTP(w, r)
			return
		}
		u, ok := app.AuthenticateDemo(r.Header.Get("Authorization"))
		if !ok {
			reject(w, 401)
			return
		}
		if u.Role != "approver" {
			reject(w, 403)
			return
		}
		body, err := io.ReadAll(http.MaxBytesReader(w, r.Body, MaxBodyBytes))
		if err != nil {
			var large *http.MaxBytesError
			if errors.As(err, &large) {
				reject(w, 413)
			} else {
				reject(w, 400)
			}
			return
		}
		ids, ok := decode(body)
		keys := r.Header.Values("Idempotency-Key")
		if !ok || len(keys) != 1 || !validKey(keys[0]) {
			reject(w, 400)
			return
		}
		ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(r.Context(), 10*time.Second)
		defer cancel()
		result, replayed, err := approve(ctx, u, keys[0], ids)
		if err != nil {
			var rejected *Rejection
			var pg *pgconn.PgError
			switch {
			case errors.As(err, &rejected):
				reject(w, rejected.Status)
			case errors.As(err, &pg) && pg.Code == "23505":
				reject(w, 409)
			default:
				log.Printf("Action transaction failed: %v", err)
				reject(w, 503)
			}
			return
		}
		w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
		if replayed {
			w.Header().Set("Idempotency-Replayed", "true")
		} else {
			w.Header().Set("Idempotency-Replayed", "false")
		}
		w.WriteHeader(200)
		_ = json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(result)
	})
}

func reject(w http.ResponseWriter, status int) {
	w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	w.WriteHeader(status)
	_ = json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(map[string]string{"error": http.StatusText(status)})
}

func decode(body []byte) ([]string, bool) {
	if !utf8.Valid(body) {
		return nil, false
	}
	d := json.NewDecoder(bytes.NewReader(body))
	if token, err := d.Token(); err != nil || token != json.Delim('{') {
		return nil, false
	}
	if key, err := d.Token(); err != nil || key != "ids" {
		return nil, false
	}
	var raw []json.RawMessage
	if d.Decode(&raw) != nil {
		return nil, false
	}
	if token, err := d.Token(); err != nil || token != json.Delim('}') {
		return nil, false
	}
	if d.Decode(new(any)) != io.EOF {
		return nil, false
	}
	ids := make([]string, len(raw))
	for i, value := range raw {
		if len(value) == 0 || value[0] != '"' || json.Unmarshal(value, &ids[i]) != nil {
			return nil, false
		}
	}
	ids, err := canonical(ids)
	return ids, err == nil
}

// Identical adapter and validation in both experiment conditions.
type Result struct {
	ApprovedIDs []string `json:"approvedIds"`
}
type Rejection struct{ Status int }

func (r *Rejection) Error() string { return fmt.Sprintf("action rejected: %d", r.Status) }

type Approve func(context.Context, app.Identity, string, []string) (Result, bool, error)

func canonical(ids []string) ([]string, error) {
	if len(ids) < 1 || len(ids) > 100 {
		return nil, &Rejection{400}
	}
	result := append([]string(nil), ids...)
	sort.Strings(result)
	for i, id := range result {
		if len(id) == 0 || len(id) > 100 || !utf8.ValidString(id) || (i > 0 && result[i-1] == id) {
			return nil, &Rejection{400}
		}
	}
	return result, nil
}

func validKey(key string) bool {
	if len(key) < 1 || len(key) > 128 {
		return false
	}
	for _, c := range key {
		if !(c >= 'a' && c <= 'z' || c >= 'A' && c <= 'Z' || c >= '0' && c <= '9' || strings.ContainsRune("._:-", c)) {
			return false
		}
	}
	return true
}

// Enhanced batch approval with audit logging and scoped idempotency.
package candidate

import (
	"context"
	"crypto/sha256"
	"encoding/hex"
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"strings"

	"github.com/XUJiahua/enterprise_agent/internal/app"
	"github.com/XUJiahua/enterprise_agent/internal/protocol"
	"github.com/jackc/pgx/v5"
	"github.com/jackc/pgx/v5/pgxpool"
	"net/http"
)

func New(ctx context.Context, pool *pgxpool.Pool, fallback http.Handler) (http.Handler, error) {
	approve := func(ctx context.Context, u app.Identity, key string, ids []string) (protocol.Result, bool, error) {
		// Validate IDs: no embedded nulls
		for _, id := range ids {
			if strings.ContainsRune(id, 0) {
				return protocol.Result{}, false, &protocol.Rejection{Status: 404}
			}
		}

		tx, err := pool.Begin(ctx)
		if err != nil {
			return protocol.Result{}, false, err
		}
		defer tx.Rollback(ctx)

		// Set RLS context
		_, err = tx.Exec(ctx, `SELECT set_config('app.tenant',$1,true),set_config('app.user',$2,true),set_config('app.role',$3,true)`, u.Tenant, u.User, u.Role)
		if err != nil {
			return protocol.Result{}, false, err
		}

		// Compute request hash for idempotency tracking
		requestHash := computeRequestHash(ids)

		// Check for existing ActionRequest with same scope (tenant+actor+operation+key)
		var existingHash string
		var existingResponse string
		err = tx.QueryRow(ctx, 
			`SELECT "requestHash", response FROM "ActionRequest" WHERE "tenantId"=$1 AND "actorId"=$2 AND operation=$3 AND key=$4`,
			u.Tenant, u.User, "bulk-approve.v3", key).Scan(&existingHash, &existingResponse)

		if err == nil {
			// Key exists. Check if it's the same ID set (idempotency replay)
			if existingHash == requestHash {
				// Same hash: return cached result as replay
				var approvedIds []string
				err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(existingResponse), &map[string]interface{}{"approvedIds": &approvedIds})
				if err == nil {
					return protocol.Result{ApprovedIDs: approvedIds}, true, nil
				}
				// If JSON parsing fails, treat as internal error
				return protocol.Result{}, false, err
			}
			// Different hash with same key: conflict
			return protocol.Result{}, false, &protocol.Rejection{Status: 409}
		} else if err != pgx.ErrNoRows {
			// Unexpected database error
			return protocol.Result{}, false, err
		}
		// No existing key: proceed with new approval

		// Query eligible purchases: submitted, not created by approver, in same tenant
		rows, err := tx.Query(ctx, 
			`SELECT id FROM "Purchase" WHERE id=ANY($1::text[]) AND "tenantId"=$2 AND "createdBy"<>$3 AND status='submitted' ORDER BY id FOR UPDATE`,
			ids, u.Tenant, u.User)
		if err != nil {
			return protocol.Result{}, false, err
		}
		defer rows.Close()

		eligible := []string{}
		for rows.Next() {
			var id string
			if err := rows.Scan(&id); err != nil {
				return protocol.Result{}, false, err
			}
			eligible = append(eligible, id)
		}
		if err := rows.Err(); err != nil {
			return protocol.Result{}, false, err
		}

		// All IDs must be eligible (already sorted by the query)
		if len(eligible) != len(ids) {
			return protocol.Result{}, false, &protocol.Rejection{Status: 409}
		}

		// Update Purchase records
		tag, err := tx.Exec(ctx,
			`UPDATE "Purchase" SET status='approved' WHERE id=ANY($1::text[]) AND "tenantId"=$2 AND "createdBy"<>$3 AND status='submitted'`,
			ids, u.Tenant, u.User)
		if err != nil {
			return protocol.Result{}, false, err
		}
		if tag.RowsAffected() != int64(len(ids)) {
			return protocol.Result{}, false, &protocol.Rejection{Status: 409}
		}

		// Build response object
		responseJSON, err := json.Marshal(map[string][]string{"approvedIds": ids})
		if err != nil {
			return protocol.Result{}, false, err
		}

		// Insert ActionRequest record (only once per scope+key, enforced by PK)
		_, err = tx.Exec(ctx,
			`INSERT INTO "ActionRequest" ("tenantId", "actorId", operation, key, "requestHash", response) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6)`,
			u.Tenant, u.User, "bulk-approve.v3", key, requestHash, responseJSON)
		if err != nil {
			return protocol.Result{}, false, err
		}

		// Insert ApprovalAudit records for each approved ID
		for _, id := range ids {
			_, err := tx.Exec(ctx,
				`INSERT INTO "ApprovalAudit" ("tenantId", "purchaseId", "approvedBy", operation, "idempotencyKey", "fromStatus", "toStatus") VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7)`,
				u.Tenant, id, u.User, "bulk-approve.v3", key, "submitted", "approved")
			if err != nil {
				return protocol.Result{}, false, err
			}
		}

		// Commit transaction
		if err := tx.Commit(ctx); err != nil {
			return protocol.Result{}, false, err
		}

		return protocol.Result{ApprovedIDs: ids}, false, nil
	}
	return protocol.HTTP(approve, fallback), nil
}

// computeRequestHash generates SHA-256 hash of the request content for idempotency.
// Format: "bulk-approve.v3\n" + sorted IDs in format "<UTF-8 byte length>:<ID>"
func computeRequestHash(ids []string) string {
	h := sha256.New()
	h.Write([]byte("bulk-approve.v3\n"))
	
	// IDs are already sorted by protocol.canonical() before reaching here
	for _, id := range ids {
		idBytes := []byte(id)
		idLen := len(idBytes) // UTF-8 byte length
		fmt.Fprintf(h, "%d:%s", idLen, id)
	}
	
	return hex.EncodeToString(h.Sum(nil))
}

		_, err = tx.Exec(ctx, `SELECT set_config('app.tenant',$1,true),set_config('app.user',$2,true),set_config('app.role',$3,true)`, u.Tenant, u.User, u.Role)
		if err != nil {
			return protocol.Result{}, false, err
		}

		// Compute request hash for idempotency tracking
		requestHash := computeRequestHash(ids)

		// Check for existing ActionRequest with same scope (tenant+actor+operation+key)
		var existingHash string
		var existingResponse string
		err = tx.QueryRow(ctx, 
			`SELECT "requestHash", response FROM "ActionRequest" WHERE "tenantId"=$1 AND "actorId"=$2 AND operation=$3 AND key=$4`,
			u.Tenant, u.User, "bulk-approve.v3", key).Scan(&existingHash, &existingResponse)

		if err == nil {
			// Key exists. Check if it's the same ID set (idempotency replay)
			if existingHash == requestHash {
				// Same hash: return cached result as replay
				var approvedIds []string
				err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(existingResponse), &map[string]interface{}{"approvedIds": &approvedIds})
				if err == nil {
					return protocol.Result{ApprovedIDs: approvedIds}, true, nil
				}
				// If JSON parsing fails, treat as internal error
				return protocol.Result{}, false, err
			}
			// Different hash with same key: conflict
			return protocol.Result{}, false, &protocol.Rejection{Status: 409}
		} else if err != pgx.ErrNoRows {
			// Unexpected database error
			return protocol.Result{}, false, err
		}
		// No existing key: proceed with new approval

		// Query eligible purchases: submitted, not created by approver, in same tenant
		rows, err := tx.Query(ctx, 
			`SELECT id FROM "Purchase" WHERE id=ANY($1::text[]) AND "tenantId"=$2 AND "createdBy"<>$3 AND status='submitted' ORDER BY id FOR UPDATE`,
			ids, u.Tenant, u.User)
		if err != nil {
			return protocol.Result{}, false, err
		}
		defer rows.Close()

		eligible := []string{}
		for rows.Next() {
			var id string
			if err := rows.Scan(&id); err != nil {
				return protocol.Result{}, false, err
			}
			eligible = append(eligible, id)
		}
		if err := rows.Err(); err != nil {
			return protocol.Result{}, false, err
		}

		// All IDs must be eligible (already sorted by the query)
		if len(eligible) != len(ids) {
			return protocol.Result{}, false, &protocol.Rejection{Status: 409}
		}

		// Update Purchase records
		tag, err := tx.Exec(ctx,
			`UPDATE "Purchase" SET status='approved' WHERE id=ANY($1::text[]) AND "tenantId"=$2 AND "createdBy"<>$3 AND status='submitted'`,
			ids, u.Tenant, u.User)
		if err != nil {
			return protocol.Result{}, false, err
		}
		if tag.RowsAffected() != int64(len(ids)) {
			return protocol.Result{}, false, &protocol.Rejection{Status: 409}
		}

		// Build response object
		responseJSON, err := json.Marshal(map[string][]string{"approvedIds": ids})
		if err != nil {
			return protocol.Result{}, false, err
		}

		// Insert ActionRequest record (only once per scope+key, enforced by PK)
		_, err = tx.Exec(ctx,
			`INSERT INTO "ActionRequest" ("tenantId", "actorId", operation, key, "requestHash", response) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6)`,
			u.Tenant, u.User, "bulk-approve.v3", key, requestHash, responseJSON)
		if err != nil {
			return protocol.Result{}, false, err
		}

		// Insert ApprovalAudit records for each approved ID
		for _, id := range ids {
			_, err := tx.Exec(ctx,
				`INSERT INTO "ApprovalAudit" ("tenantId", "purchaseId", "approvedBy", operation, "idempotencyKey", "fromStatus", "toStatus") VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7)`,
				u.Tenant, id, u.User, "bulk-approve.v3", key, "submitted", "approved")
			if err != nil {
				return protocol.Result{}, false, err
			}
		}

		// Commit transaction
		if err := tx.Commit(ctx); err != nil {
			return protocol.Result{}, false, err
		}

		return protocol.Result{ApprovedIDs: ids}, false, nil
	}
	return protocol.HTTP(approve, fallback), nil
}

// computeRequestHash generates SHA-256 hash of the request content for idempotency.
// Format: "bulk-approve.v3\n" + sorted IDs in format "<UTF-8 byte length>:<ID>"
func computeRequestHash(ids []string) string {
	h := sha256.New()
	h.Write([]byte("bulk-approve.v3\n"))
	
	// IDs are already sorted by protocol.canonical() before reaching here
	for _, id := range ids {
		idBytes := []byte(id)
		idLen := len(idBytes) // UTF-8 byte length
		fmt.Fprintf(h, "%d:%s", idLen, id)
	}
	
	return hex.EncodeToString(h.Sum(nil))
}
